name: Simple zh greeting run
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--gemma-3-270m-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && printf "\xe4\xbd\xa0\xe5\xa5\xbd\xef\xbc\x81\n" | timeout 150 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin 2 c ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/bpe.bin 1000 950 48 > /tmp/gifdemozh2.log 2>&1; echo EXIT=$?; awk "/chat ready/{f=1} f" /tmp/gifdemozh2.log | cut -c1-55 | head -12'
